postInferenceAmendments.failure: Claude browser HTTP 400. The core schema contained 17 unions; the collaboration envelope added two. A bounded diagnostic then exposed a missing $defs forwarding in the initial factoring change.
postInferenceAmendments.change: Factor identical primitive unions into local non-recursive definitions and forward them through the collaboration envelope. Preserve all accepted values, cases, budgets per trial and expectations.
postInferenceAmendments.regressionPolicy: Original browser cases are now development/regression evidence. Preserve the failed initial trial and all Luna successes; do not call a later matched run fresh independent holdout.
